Domine, Deus virtutum,
qui collapsa reparas et reparata conservas,

translations.text:
Lord, God of hosts, you restore what has fallen and preserve what has been restored. Increase the peoples who are to be renewed in the sanctification of your name, so that all who are washed in holy Baptism may always be guided by your inspiration. Through Christ our Lord.
R. Amen.
